failure_modes.name: Stage cooling drift
failure_modes.root_cause: Partially closed or fouled valve in the wafer stage cooling loop reduces coolant flow, so stage temperature drifts upward.
symptoms: Overlay getting worse over the last shifts, stage temperature alarm this morning.
Recurring stage temperature errors and overlay correction warnings since yesterday.
recommended_checks: Verify stage cooling loop flow rate against specification.
Inspect cooling loop valves and filters touched during the last maintenance.
logbook_clues: Preventive maintenance on stage cooling loop: replaced filter cartridge, valve V3 re-seated.

failure_modes.name: Chamber vacuum leak
failure_modes.root_cause: Degraded O-ring on a chamber access port causes a slow vacuum leak.
symptoms: Pump-down takes much longer than usual and we saw a pump-down timeout.
Chamber pressure excursions after the access port was opened.
recommended_checks: Perform helium leak test on chamber access ports.
Inspect and replace access port O-rings.
logbook_clues: Chamber access port opened for sensor inspection, port closed afterwards.

failure_modes.name: Light source energy instability
failure_modes.root_cause: Aging light source module produces unstable pulse energy.
symptoms: Dose instability warnings and occasional pulse energy errors during exposure.
CD uniformity complaints from the fab, dose warnings in the event log.
recommended_checks: Review light source module pulse counter against its service interval.
Run light source energy stability diagnostic.
logbook_clues: Light source module pulse counter at 92% of service interval.

failure_modes.name: Reticle gripper wear
failure_modes.root_cause: Worn gripper pads on the reticle handler reduce grip force.
symptoms: Reticle transfer retries piling up, one gripper force error.
Reticle exchange is slow and keeps retrying.
recommended_checks: Measure gripper force with calibration tool.
Inspect gripper pads for wear and replace if below specification.
logbook_clues: Reticle handler cycle count approaching gripper pad replacement interval.

failure_modes.name: Interferometer contamination
failure_modes.root_cause: Contamination on an interferometer mirror increases position measurement noise.
symptoms: Overlay correction warnings and position measurement noise warnings.
Overlay drifting, metrology reports noisy position measurement.
logbook_clues: Particle count in the stage compartment slightly elevated after a hood intervention.

failure_modes.name: Controller firmware regression
failure_modes.root_cause: A defect in the recently installed controller firmware causes CPU overload and watchdog resets.
symptoms: Machine rebooted itself twice, communication timeouts before that.
Watchdog resets since the weekend, tool keeps dropping out of production.
recommended_checks: Compare controller firmware version with known-issue list.
Roll back to previous firmware release if a known issue matches.
logbook_clues: Controller software updated to the latest release.

failure_modes.name: Purge gas flow restriction
failure_modes.root_cause: Clogged purge gas filter restricts flow, causing pressure excursions.
symptoms: Purge flow low warnings together with pressure excursions.
Pressure excursions in the chamber, purge flow looks lower than normal.
recommended_checks: Check purge gas filter differential pressure.
Replace purge gas filter if differential pressure exceeds limit.
logbook_clues: Purge gas filter differential pressure reading noted as high-normal.

failure_modes.name: Lens heating calibration drift
failure_modes.root_cause: Outdated lens heating calibration causes focus to drift during long exposure sequences.
symptoms: Focus errors toward the end of long lots, overlay warnings as well.
Focus out of tolerance on high-throughput recipes.
recommended_checks: Check date of last lens heating calibration.
logbook_clues: Lens heating calibration skipped during last maintenance due to time constraints.
